headline: 螢火蟲
brief:
# 網美小豬 EP5〈螢火蟲之夜〉

## 故事前提

粉粉在夜晚森林裡被螢火蟲圍繞。拉遠：地下停車場，日光燈一閃一閃，螢火蟲是一串小燈泡，從一根釣竿垂下來；水豚男友站在梯子上舉著釣竿，燈串的線接在他脖子上的行動電源，蚊子繞著他飛。她重擺姿勢，整串燈掉下來纏在她身上，一顆一顆熄掉——行動電源沒電了。

## 角色

- 粉粉（fenfen）、水豚男友（capy）：同系列定裝照；粉粉穿系列招牌的白蕾絲洋裝、大草帽配粉紅緞帶、珍珠髮夾。水豚男友脖子上的行動電源是這集的道具。

## 站主觀點

零台詞；系列公式：唯美 → 閃光一瞄 → 拉遠揭曉 → 男友 → 成品照破綻 → 重擺被整。EP5 題目由本批企劃，照系列公式；男友的固定配件行動電源第一次派上用場。

## 格式

- 9:16，約 16 秒；Colab 首格與 H3 片段。

## 大綱

### 選項 A：螢火蟲之夜
一行說明：螢火蟲圍繞 → 閃光一瞄 → 地下停車場的燈串釣竿 → 男友用行動電源供電、被蚊子叮 → 成品照樹林裡有水豚臉 → 燈串掉下來纏住她、一顆顆熄掉。
開場鉤子：夜裡的螢火蟲，有一隻吊在一條細線上。

shots.ff: Close-up at night of Fenfen the pink pig herself in a white lace sundress, a wide straw sun hat with a long pink satin ribbon and a pearl hair clip, a dreamy three-quarter profile smile, dozens of tiny glowing fireflies floating around her in soft focus in a dark forest; one glowing firefly near the corner visibly hangs from a thin string.
shots.clip: The pink pig shown in <Picture 1> gazes dreamily at the glowing lights around her and slowly raises a hoof toward one; the light in the corner bobs up and down on its thin string. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium close-up at night of Fenfen the pink pig herself in a white lace sundress and wide straw sun hat with a pink ribbon, frozen in a dreamy profile pose, tiny warm lights glowing around her.
shots.clip: A bright camera flash fires once; the pink pig shown in <Picture 1> keeps her face frozen and only her eyes slowly slide to the lower right; one eyebrow twitches. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Wide shot of a dim concrete underground parking garage at night with one flickering fluorescent tube, grey concrete pillars and an oil stain on the floor, no signs: Fenfen the pink pig herself in her white lace sundress and straw hat poses among three small potted plants; above her dangles a string of tiny warm fairy lights hanging from a long fishing line that reaches in from the top right of the frame.
shots.clip: The pink pig shown in <Picture 1> holds her dreamy pose; the fairy lights dangle and swing slowly on the fishing line above her; the fluorescent tube flickers. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: Medium shot in the dim underground parking garage of the capybara boyfriend himself standing on a stepladder, holding a long fishing rod out toward the left edge of the frame with both front paws, a thin cable running from the rod to the glowing power bank hanging around his neck, his deadpan face lit from below, three mosquitoes circling his head.
shots.clip: The capybara shown in <Picture 1> holds the fishing rod steady and gently jiggles it so the line bobs; a mosquito lands on his nose; one ear flicks; his deadpan face does not change. The camera holds a static shot.

shots.ff: The finished photo filling the vertical frame with a thin white photo border, a plain photo print with no title, no letters and no logo: Fenfen the pink pig in a white lace sundress and straw hat in a magical night forest surrounded by glowing fireflies; deep in the dark trees in the background, a deadpan capybara face in a green bucket hat glows, lit from below by a small light.
shots.clip: The photo shown in <Picture 1> holds still; the glowing capybara face in the dark trees slowly blinks once. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

shots.ff: Medium shot in the dim underground parking garage of Fenfen the pink pig herself in her white lace sundress and straw hat, taking her dreamy profile pose again among the potted plants, tiny warm fairy lights dangling above her.
shots.clip: The pink pig shown in <Picture 1> takes her dreamy pose; suddenly the whole string of fairy lights drops from above and tangles over her hat and shoulders; the lights die one by one; she holds the pose, smile unchanged, under the flickering fluorescent tube. The camera holds a static shot.
